declaredAdvisories.reason: The onboarding agent is removed. Its six REST endpoints under /api/v1/ee/projects/{projectUuid}/agent-onboarding now return 404, and POST /api/v1/org/playground-projects/ensure no longer accepts the agent_onboarding_wait trigger. Project admins scripting these undocumented onboarding endpoints would see the errors; every other playground trigger behaves as before.

impact.firstPartyOnly: The web app's onboarding screens are the only client of these operations, and they are removed in the same change. During a rolling update an old homepage tab gets a 404 for the latest run and falls back to generated suggestion chips, while an old run page shows its not-found state until refresh, which is safe because no onboarding work depends on it.
